# Governing guidance
Harbor Help offers scheduled video appointments. Appointments are not recorded.
Screen sharing is optional, needs the reader's consent and can be stopped at any time.
The adviser cannot control the device or open its files. This is not an emergency service.
The support route is help@harbor.example. Keep this address exactly.
Avoid unsupported assurances such as guaranteed, always safe or risk-free.
Keep the service name Harbor Help. Keep the support and id fields unchanged.
Rewrite title and explanation for the specified audience, preserving every fact above.
The archive is outside this task and must stay byte-for-byte unchanged.
Explain the choices patiently without assumptions about ability or familiarity with technology.
